watches.description: Available in Brushed Silver Case only now. The Mach By Detroit Mint is a vintage styled bullhead chronograph like the famous bullheads of the 1960s and 1970s. It has been a favorite way of customizing this watch so I wanted to offer it to customers as an option. Will also come with the standard black leather band as well as the jubilee single pass seatbelt nylon for that more unique look. Also check out the store for the Hollywood leather cuff to add a more vintage 1970s look to this piece. The Hollywood Cuff will need to be purchased in addition to this watch as it is a custom built piece that is built up and fitted to this watch here at our shop in Detroit. This is a 40mm case 9 to 3 and 46mm lug to lug. The case is 13mm thick so it is very comfortable to wear.

watches.name: Detroit Mint Caretta World Time Calculator Turtle Dive Watch Red Sky
watches.description: The classic turtle diver in deep red sunray dial with the vintage inspired World Time Calculator Dial. This is a unique look that takes this piece to a more custom look. The world time calculator is not a GMT but rather the bezel is used to perform a basic 24 hour calculation on the time anywhere in the world. Set your city to the correct position on the 24 hour scale and then read forward or back word depending on the direction you are trying to calculate. It's a very cool vintage gadget from before the GMT was popular. The Specs on the Caretta are the same as our standard except this comes with both the Vulcanized Vanilla Rubber Band as well as a Vintage Black leather for more of a pilot look. Specs: All 316 Stainless steel case and hardware construction Solid Sapphire Crystal with Anti-reflective coating on the underside C3 Swiss Superluminova on the polished hands and applied markers 24 Hour timer markings on the Rehault ring for calculating world time Screw Down Crown and Case back to achieve 200 m water resistance. Yes this can be used for recreational scuba diving. I use mine all the time. Vulcanized Vanilla Scented Rubber strap with machined buckle Vintage Leather strap also included. Comes with watch roll and pin changing tool Options: Nato or single pass straps instead of leather (just ask if you prefer something different) Stainless Steel fitted solid end link milled clasp bracelet looks amazing on this watch and can be added and installed for you. We can also fit it for you if you know your wrist size. Available with blue or silver world time bezel but this really looks great with the black and red one. All Detroit Mint Watches come with a Warranty that works like this: 30 Days no questions asked returns, repair, replace, refund 90 Days evaluation. If there is anything wrong with the watch in terms of craftsmanship, quality, durability, just return the watch for a repair or replacement Lifetime service contract and warranty. If for any reason the watch needs service or repair send it back to Detroit Mint and we will perform the required service or repair for a maximum cost of $75. Usually less but a max of $75. All Detroit Mint watches are designed, customized, final assembly completed, inspected, packaged, shipped, and serviced from the Detroit Mint Shop just outside of Detroit, MI, USA.

We have recreated the look and feel of the Automatic Bullhead seen in famous movies and on stuntmen since the late 1960s. Check our bands to find the Hollywood leather cuff as a real vintage option for those serious Pitt Men. Specifications: 40 mm diameter 46 mm lug to lug 20 mm band and lug width Stainless Body- With PVD gold plating in a deep gold and brushed finish Sapphire Domed Crystal with AR coating Swiss C3 Lumina Detroit Mint special bi axial automatic 30 jewel 28800 bullhead orientated movement based on the 7750 clone but with the early 7733 design layout and latest updated designs for durability and automatic winding. Each movement is calibrated and tuned prior to shipping. Only 14.5 mm thick with a full automatic chronograph movement. All Detroit Mint watches are finished, customized, shipped, and serviced from our shop just outside of Detroit Michigan. Full warranty and service agreement included. SHIPPING NOW!
